title: Ignatius, 2 Clement and the Epistle to Diognetus
summary: Five more early Christian writings now have a Plain English Translation from the Greek, with study notes, manuscript differences and chapter pages: three letters Ignatius of Antioch wrote on his way to die in Rome, to the Ephesians, the Romans and the Smyrnaeans; 2 Clement, a second-century sermon read aloud in worship; and the Epistle to Diognetus, with its picture of Christians as resident aliens in their own homelands. None of them is in any church's Bible. Four new topic pages come with them: the Incarnation, Docetism, Defending the Faith, and Christians as Resident Aliens.
